title: A Certified Robustness Framework for Backdoor Poisoning Attacks using $f$-Divergences
abstract: arXiv:2610.34934v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning systems trained on untrusted data are vulnerable to data and backdoor poisoning attacks, in which an adversary corrupts training and test samples to manipulate predictions at inference time. Randomized smoothing yields provable defenses against such attacks, but existing applications to train-time robustness are limited to specific threat models and smoothing mechanisms. We propose a general framework that allows expressing complex adversary constraints on the number of corrupted training examples, feature and label perturbation magnitudes, and test-time corruptions. Our framework randomizes inputs by combining data subsampling with feature, label and test-sample noising. We develop a composable certification procedure based on $f$-divergences that handles arbitrary combinations of threat models and noising strategies, and recovers several prior certification regimes exactly as special cases. We demonstrate our framework

translated_title: 基于 $f$-散度的后门投毒攻击认证鲁棒性框架
translated_abstract: 在不可信数据上训练的机器学习系统容易受到数据和后门投毒攻击，攻击者会破坏训练和测试样本，以在推理时操纵预测结果。随机平滑为此类攻击提供了可证明的防御方法，但现有针对训练时鲁棒性的应用仅限于特定的威胁模型和平滑机制。我们提出了一个通用框架，能够表达复杂的对手约束，包括被破坏训练样本的数量、特征和标签扰动的幅度以及测试时的破坏。我们的框架通过将数据子采样与特征、标签和测试样本加噪相结合来随机化输入。我们开发了一种基于 $f$-散度的可组合认证程序，能够处理威胁模型和加噪策略的任意组合，并可将若干先前的认证机制精确地作为特例恢复出来。我们展示了我们的框架（原文摘要至此不完整）
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于 $f$-散度的通用认证鲁棒性框架，通过数据子采样与特征、标签及测试样本加噪的组合来随机化输入，可处理任意威胁模型与加噪策略的组合，并将先前多种认证机制作为特例统一涵盖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general certified robustness framework based on $f$-divergences that randomizes inputs via data subsampling combined with feature, label, and test-sample noising, handling arbitrary combinations of threat models and noising strategies while recovering prior certification regimes as special cases.
